g1.label: 1. Irish people ___ to North America
g1.why: To emigrate means to leave your country to live in another one.

g2.label: 2. Not enough food
g2.why: A famine is a period when many people do not have enough food.

g3.label: 3. The Irish ___
g3.why: A diaspora is a people living around the world, away from their original homeland.

g4.label: 4. Ireland's western ___
g4.why: The coastline is the land along the sea, with its cliffs and islands.

g5.label: 5. Oral ___
g5.why: Oral storytelling means telling stories aloud, which kept memories alive.

g6.label: 6. An Irish ___
g6.why: An accent is the way people from a region pronounce words.

g7.label: 7. A person's ___
g7.why: Your identity is who you are and how you see yourself.

g8.label: 8. A better ___
g8.why: An opportunity is a chance for something better, like work.

g1.label: 1. By the end of the famine, families ___
g1.why: 'By the end of' + past needs the past perfect: had + past participle.

g2.label: 2. By 1900, millions ___
g2.why: 'By 1900' shows an action completed before a past time: past perfect.

g3.label: 3. When the ship ___ in New York
g3.why: A single past event in a 'when' clause takes the simple past.

g4.label: 4. Because they ___ for better work
g4.why: Past progressive describes their ongoing wish at the time they left.

g5.label: 5. After emigrants ___ new communities
g5.why: The communities came first, so use the past perfect for the earlier action.

g6.label: 6. Modern Ireland ___ a lot since
g6.why: 'Since' + a change continuing to now takes the present perfect.

g7.label: 7. If young people moved abroad today, they ___
g7.why: Conditional type 2: if + past simple, then would + infinitive.

g8.label: 8. The writer ___ family stories before she visited
g8.why: She heard the stories before her visit, so the earlier action is past perfect.
